scene: a single brass door key lying on a bare wooden kitchen table, a small green mark of verdigris on the bow, the paper tag from the cutting shop still looped on with string, a glass of water and a folded tea towel pushed to the far edge, one low lamp from the left, evening dark in the window behind

a lumpy papier mache head the size of a football on a paper-covered classroom table, newsprint still showing through the paste, two thumbed hollows for eyes and a lopsided open mouth, a jar of brushes and a torn strip of gummed tape beside it, flat fluorescent light from above

a handwritten biro notice taped inside a bakery window, the paper curled at one corner, the metal shutter half down across the glass above it, empty wire bread baskets stacked behind the pane, a wet pavement and a bollard reflected in the dark glass

a wide bowl of deep brick-red soup on a scratched steel kitchen bench, the surface still moving, a slick of oil across it and a scatter of black pepper, a heavy enamel pan with the lid tipped against it behind, a folded paper bag of onion skins at the back, one bare bulb overhead

the pressure dial of a wall-mounted domestic boiler in close view, white face with a red needle sitting just past 1.2, a smear of thumbprint on the plastic cover, the grey filling loop and its lever below, a kitchen cupboard door and a tea towel at the edge of frame, hard phone-flash light

a kitchen table taken over by school work, two canvas bags upright and open, sketchbooks in leaning stacks with sugar paper edges sticking out, a mug used as a paperweight, a red pen lying across a mark sheet, a cold grey window behind and the chair pushed back

a hospital car park at eight in the morning under fresh snow, unbroken white across the painted bays and along the tops of the barrier rails, one set of tyre tracks curving to the exit, a lit sodium lamp still burning and a low white sky, the hill falling away beyond the fence

a slatted wooden bench on high open ground with hailstones caught in the gaps between the slats, wet dark wood, a dented steel flask standing on one end, coarse winter grass bent flat around the legs, a reservoir and low cloud behind

a small brass hook screwed into a painted door frame with two keys hanging from it on separate rings, the paint chipped where the screw went in, a coat sleeve and the edge of a door in soft focus behind, flat daylight from a hallway window
